notes.title: Win an epic OMEGA 6 The Triangle Stars bundle!
notes.content:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45245741/0c12549a936c5d3914a61ebbada66cc4d7a3a8d2.jpg

Hey all! OMEGA 6 The Triangle Stars launches on Friday, February 28th. Now that's a reason to celebrate! 🎉

We're giving a packed OMEGA 6 bundle. Follow to enter: https://gleam.io/KFNKT/omega-6-the-triangle-stars-launch-celebration-giveaway

We're giving away the following to one (1) lucky winner


 Nintendo Switch OLED Console. Approximate Retail Value (ARV) $349.99 USD.
 A physical copy of OMEGA 6 The Triangle Stars on Nintendo Switch. Approximate Retail Value (ARV) $34.99 USD.
 A CRKD Nitro Deck Retro Purple Limited Edition with Carry Case. Approximate Retail Value (ARV) $69.99 USD.
 An OMEGA 6 prequel comic sign by Takaya Imamura.


Additionally, five (5) winners will receive a digital game key for OMEGA 6 The Triangle Stars on Steam or Nintendo Switch.

Good luck!
